name: flowdown-site

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --ssr src/app/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run check && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name flowdown --branch main

description: The landing page and the docs of flowdown, at flowdown.dev.
